content:
Locally path connected spaces were added back in mathlib3 here. Renaming to LocallyPathConnectedSpace would make it easier to find and more consistent with other typeclasses for topological spaces, in particular we have LocallyConnectedSpace.

I havent found discussion about this previously.

Would this make sense?
I'm in favor, but I'm only one maintainer, so please wait for other input. I'll note that I have searched for "LocallyPath..." in the docs and have been temporarily confused that it returned empty.

Jireh Loreaux said:

I'm in favor, but I'm only one maintainer, so please wait for other input. I'll note that I have searched for "LocallyPath..." in the docs and have been temporarily confused that it returned empty.

I'm also in favour; this still makes only two maintainers, but it is already the double :two:
(I also find the new name more consistent. If we think the increase in length is fine, I'm on board.)
I don't like abbreviations unless they're really obvious. I don't think Loc for Locally quite meets that threshold.

There was a recent proposal to shorten some names (e.g., ContinuousLinearMap -> ContLinMap or something like that) with motivation "otherwise we abbreviate them to something like CLM in definitions that are bundled versions of other definitions".

To expand on my opinion a bit. I think definition names should be readable both to people familiar with the maths and the API, and to people that aren't. If I don't know what a locally path-connected space is, I'm going to have more trouble figuring out what the Loc in LocPathConnectedSpace means.
